definitions.explanation: A device for measuring body temperature.

examples.japanese: {体温計|たいおんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: To take one's temperature with a thermometer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{非接触|ひせっしょく}→非接触：15813_hisesshoku⟧{体温計|たいおんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{体温計|たいおんけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧37.5⟦{度|ど}→度：09845_do⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。

notes:
{体温計|たいおんけい} is a compound of ⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧ (body temperature) + ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (meter/gauge). Used specifically for measuring body temperature, not room or outdoor temperature.

TYPES:
- ⟦{水銀|すいぎん}→水銀：17807_suigin⟧{体温計|たいおんけい}: mercury thermometer (traditional, being phased out)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{体温計|たいおんけい}: digital thermometer (most common today)
- ⟦{非接触|ひせっしょく}→非接触：15813_hisesshoku⟧{体温計|たいおんけい}: contactless/infrared thermometer

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体温計|たいおんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure with a thermometer
- {体温計|たいおんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧: to place the thermometer under the arm

USAGE:
Normal body temperature in Japan is typically cited as 36-37°C. A reading of 37.5°C or above is generally considered a fever (⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧).

SIMILAR 〜{計|けい} WORDS:
- ⟦{温度計|おんどけい}→温度計：25699_ondokei⟧: thermometer (for room/outdoor temperature)
- ⟦{血圧計|けつあつけい}→血圧計：15567_ketsuatsukei⟧: blood pressure monitor
